notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.7
notes.content:
Update log:

1. Fixed the problem of getting stuck when using displacement skills

2. Reduced the cooldown time of camp treatment

3. Increased the number of embers rewarded by elite monsters

4. Fixed the problem that you can still click to restart after the game fails

notes.title: Devlog 01: Deck-building Festival and Development Progress Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/e76fcf26fc6295ca7ae26b7bc949676023306490.jpg

Hi everyone, it's been a while!

I'm here to share some good news with you all —  "INDIES 2: BURNING KINDLING " has now joined the Steam Deck-building Festival!

By the way, development of the game is going smoothly, pretty much as we expected!

The foundational features of the chess-strategy part have been completed, and next up, we'll be focusing on the DBG (Deck-building Game) aspect, as well as the Roguelike elements.

Here are some little teasers, of course, the game screenshots are not final versions~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/e63b7afe02a5e8411a6bab20b697144042a62d1e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/235197dd3f4380f195ef25e4b0e8d12270c44d24.jpg

So, if you're also interested in "INDIES 2: BURNING KINDLING," be sure to add it to your Steam wishlist!

Wishing you all a happy day!

——Coffee
